name: Day log Part C smoke test

definition.title: Day log Part C smoke test ({{run}})
definition.body_md: Phil's live check of Day log Part C — People (0131), shipped 2026-09-21. The API path was smoke-tested from the PC with a made-up person over two test days; this ticket is the human half: does a real person's page read true. Do it after the Part B check — it needs at least one day whose people and facts you have approved. Tick as you go; anything that fails stays unticked with a comment naming the step id.

steps_definition.title: Day log Part C smoke test

values.label: The person you approved onto a day in the Part B check

intro.verdict_html: Two phases, about 10 minutes. Phase 1 reads {{friend}}'s page against what you know you approved. Phase 2 adds a second day and watches the numbers move, then checks the interviewer now knows who they are.
prerequisites: The Part B check is done: at least one closed day where {{friend}} was approved as WAS THERE and a fact or two about them was approved

steps.title: People → the row for {{friend}} shows "N days together" alongside mentions and quotes; someone who has never been on a day shows nothing extra

fields.label: Days together shown on the row

steps.title: Open {{friend}}. Below the three columns is a Days block: the count with first and last dates in its header — matching what you approved
Timeline: one row per scene they were in, newest day first, the date shown once per day, each with its place and one line. The date opens that day's journal page

Facts and preferences: only facts about {{friend}} (not yours), each with a kind tag and its day. Places and food together: grouped by place with a day count, a linked place opening Places, what you ate, drank and spent there underneath. Milestones, if you approved one, sit at the top in the accent colour

fields.label: Anything on the page that is wrong or is not theirs

steps.title: Nothing you rejected, and nothing still waiting in the review queue, appears anywhere in the block

Journal → another past date → QUICK → "{{friend}} / <the same place as before, same wording> / one line" → scores. In review, {{friend}} is a WAS THERE card (not a new person), and a place you already created does not come back as a PLACE card. Approve the day's items
Back on {{friend}}: days together went up by one, last seen moved to the new date, the place's day count went up, and the new scene tops the timeline
A third past date → TALK → mention {{friend}} by name in your first message. The interviewer does NOT ask who they are. Type "done", give the scores, then delete or keep the day as you like
